title: VMDK (VMware Virtual Disk) signature
summary: A VMDK (VMware Virtual Disk) file begins with the 4-byte magic 'KDMV' (0x4B 0x44 0x4D 0x56) for sparse (monolithic) VMDKs, or 'COWD' (0x43 0x4F 0x57 0x44) for older (COW) format.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Sparse VMDK header: magic (4), version (4), flags (4), capacity (8), grain size (8), descriptor offset (8), descriptor size (8), ... .
VMDK supports split (2GB chunks), sparse, and flat (raw) variants.
Used by VMware Workstation/ESXi and supported by QEMU/KVM.
